text: ast-outline skill and repository AGENTS say paths may follow the command directly, but installed CLI requires the explicit outline subcommand. Document the accepted syntax to prevent a dead-end invocation.
Runtime imports omit file extensions while ast-outline needs the exact extension; a mixed lookup with a nonexistent path aborts the whole batch. Per-path diagnostics would make exploration faster.

React plan verification commands use react-doctor --scope <path>, but current React Doctor only accepts full/files/changed/lines. The command silently ignores file paths, so plans need supported changed-file syntax.
